description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kalalpitiya, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510600 (23/0605)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extent, owners, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement matters, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
